all expected primary B2 snapshot streams complete and independently checked

bootstrap.method: unchanged10000 paired-seed percentile95%, type7(.025,.975), fixed analysis_seed20261018
bootstrap.index: SHA256 SEMANTIC_CANON_V2(key); q first64 big-endian; limit=18446744073709551610; if q>=limit increment counter else index=q%10; each replicate10 indices, same vector across all methods/conditions
bootstrap.aggregate: Within each condition resample paired seed p and take seed mean. Mandatory descriptive macro: within each seed equal-weight mean of12 selected loaded conditions, then mean over seeds; reuse same bootstrap seed-index vector for every condition/method/macro. Macro never compensates for any condition failure.
bootstrap.interpretation: Pointwise descriptive intervals conditional on selected calibration configs and VALID_FULL coverage; not independent confirmatory evidence or simultaneous-coverage claim.

scope: SUPPORTED concerns projected remaining-H-path opportunity in this bounded public model only; not actual H benefit/L compliance or independent causal mapping success.
